subject.title: fix(codex): normalize raw plugin payloads in dynamic tool bridge (fixes #97913) (AI-assisted)

question: Which raw-payload normalization branch should become the canonical landing path after the serialization and real-proof blockers are addressed?
rationale: Two open PRs target the same linked issue, and this PR still has a correctness finding plus missing real behavior proof, so automation cannot safely choose or merge a branch on its own.

options.title: Repair this branch
options.body: Keep this PR as the candidate only if it adopts total serialization, adds a non-JSON regression, and includes accessible redacted real app-server/plugin proof.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape once its proof and CI are reviewable.

options.title: Pause both candidates
options.body: Hold both PRs until a maintainer specifies the exact bridge-boundary contract and proof requirement.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader sibling
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97916 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer its broader normalization shape once its proof and CI are reviewable.
